{{Top|leg}}
'''Advanced blasters''', also known as '''advanced lasers''', were an improvement to various [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. As indicated by the name, they improved the firepower of a ship's laser weapons systems.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike}}
Upon rescuing the then-recently defected [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and escorting him back to the landing zone on speeder bikes, then-leader of [[Red Squadron]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] took the left fork of the path upon noticing the advanced lasers nearby.
{{Endgame}}

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)}}
Skywalker, the leader of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], briefly disengaged from the raid on the final [[Tibanna gas platform]] on [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] during a mission to [[Battle above Taloraan|destroy]] Imperial-owned [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]] canisters by dive-bombing into [[Taloraan City]] nearby and retrieving the advanced blasters that were situated within the floating city's town square, carefully navigating through the buildings to avoid smashing into them.
{{Endgame}}

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader}}
During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], acting as leader of Rogue Squadron after Skywalker was shot down, circled back to the then-recently destroyed shield generator at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] to retrieve the advanced blasters among the ruined wreck.
{{Endgame}}
